problem: A page's or batch's grade label is derived from the weighted overall_score instead of the accessibility_score, the subject of the report (plan 29, D1). A batch with accessibility 49 and overall 62 read "D" while the accessibility score alone is an "F".
evidence: Startkorpus item from issue #511 ("Batch-Klassifikation aus der falschen Score-Basis"), reproduced live during the report-critic skill's dry-run eval against reports/casoon-batch-en301549.json. The certificate half of the original finding went away with the certificate itself (#911); the grade half is still checked.
expected: report-lint's grade check compares grade against the band of accessibility_score on summary and on every page, never against overall_score.
counter_examples: A report whose grade matches the band of its accessibility_score must pass even when overall_score falls into a different band.
